_about: Routing robustness set v1. Independently authored: the author had no access to src/query/route.py, engine.py, resolve.py, config/relations.yaml, or either router implementation. Frozen BEFORE either router was run against it.
_independence: Author read only the corpus, eval/answer_key.json and docs/limitations.md. config/relations.yaml was withheld specifically because it is the cue-based router vocabulary source; an author who read it would have biased the comparison toward that router.

_groups.A_paraphrase: 4 re-wordings of each of the 7 dev 1B questions, one per axis (synonym, reordering, indirect, colloquial). Gold answer held identical to the source question.
_groups.B_novel: New multi-hop questions traced by hand against the wiki.
_groups.C_unanswerable: Questions the system should refuse: misspelling, absent entity, or a relation the pages never record.

questions.question: In which stronghold is the gauntlet that Maelis Harrowick the Pale has wielded since 399 AS kept?

She also wields The Psalter of Seven Sorrows, so the word 'gauntlet' and the year 399 AS both disambiguate. The Gauntlet's forging year is contested but its housing is not.

questions.question: Which faction rules the keep that houses the ward Ignatz Ashgrove the Oathless has wielded since 281 AS?

The date and the class word 'ward' separate The Hollow Edge from the Chalice of Ashdeep, which he also wields.

questions.question: Which relic has Cerys Sablewode the Ashen wielded since 356 AS?
questions.notes: REFUSE - misspelled entity. The corpus contains 'Cerys Sablewood the Ashen'; the string 'Sablewode' appears nowhere in the archive (checked across wiki, codex, chronicles and ephemera). An honest system should say it cannot find that name, or ask whether Cerys Sablewood the Ashen was meant, rather than silently answering as if the name matched.

questions.question: Which faction won the Siege of Emberfall Bridge?
questions.notes: REFUSE - the conflict does not exist. The corpus records six conflicts (The Accord of Mournthrone, The Leaden Accord, The Purge of Blackport, The War of Drowned Light, The War of Endless Vigil, The Winter Reckoning). The string 'Emberfall' does not occur anywhere in the archive. Answering with any faction is a fabrication.

questions.question: Which stronghold does Tobias Ravenscar command?
questions.notes: REFUSE - the person does not exist. The string 'Ravenscar' does not occur anywhere in the archive. The surname is close in shape to real corpus names such as Ossric Ravensmoor, so this specifically tests whether a near-miss on a name gets silently snapped onto a real entity.

questions.question: Who was Ederon Fellgard's mentor?
questions.notes: REFUSE - real entity, relation never recorded. Ederon Fellgard's page has no mentor row, and its prose states outright that the record does not identify family members, friends, enemies, mentors, apprentices, colleagues or political connections. Mentorship edges are dense elsewhere in the corpus, so the temptation to borrow one from a similarly-named Fellgard is the exact failure this catches.

questions.question: Which conflict did House Morvain win?
questions.notes: REFUSE - real entity, relation never recorded. House Morvain's page records it only as a belligerent in The War of Endless Vigil and The Purge of Blackport and carries no victory row of any kind; the recorded victors of those two are The Bleeding Crown and the Iron-Ring Cartel respectively. Being present at a conflict is not winning it, and naming either conflict here would be a guess.

questions.question: Which faction does the Marsh Revenant serve?
questions.notes: REFUSE - real entity, relation never recorded. Both the Marsh Revenant's wiki page and its codex bestiary entry state explicitly that no affiliation is recorded for it and that it needs no declared master. Other creatures in the corpus do carry a link from creature to conflict, so a router may be tempted to infer an allegiance from one; there is none to infer here.
